dimension_info.Onshore Wind: Installed onshore wind capacity, summed over all 34 nodes.
dimension_info.Offshore Wind: Installed fixed-bottom offshore wind capacity (AC grid connection), summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.Floating Wind: Installed floating offshore wind capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.Solar: Installed fixed-tilt solar PV capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.Tracking Solar: Installed single-axis tracking solar PV capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.Gas Power: Installed combined-cycle gas turbine (CCGT) capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.Battery Storage: Installed battery storage energy capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.Hydrogen Storage: Installed hydrogen storage energy capacity, summed over all nodes.
dimension_info.System Cost: Total annual system cost (annualised capital plus operational costs). This is the objective function being minimized.
